svg.title: Francis Drake’s Circumnavigation of the Globe Aboard the Golden Hind (1577–80)
svg.desc: 16th-century Natural Earth 1 world historical atlas showing seamless continents without anachronistic modern borders, highlighting England, Spain and the Spanish Viceroyalties of New Spain and Peru, Portugal and the Cape Spice Route, the Moluccas (Ternate), and Sir Francis Drake’s complete westward 1577–80 voyage track aboard the Golden Hind.
